identity:
You fall, and fall, and fall, through an endless black void devoid of stars.  No light.  No sound.  No sensation of wind.  You try to shout, to scream, but hear nothing.  When you try to grab your own hand, you cannot feel it.  There is only the dark.

Perhaps fortunately, your mind gives way before your body does.
